subsets._rule: random.Random(seed) shuffles the pool of train cases (transitional cases removed first); for each target in increasing order the walk over that order adds a case whenever it brings the frame count closer to the target, continuing from the previous target's subset, so subsets are nested and whole cases are drawn. Realized N = the resulting frame count. N=0 = the stage-2 list with no real frames of the device.
